residual_risks: CANCEL/RESCHEDULE enforcement semantics (Integration audit Observation A): uniform rule evaluation can block cancelling the very booking a cap counts, and flag a reschedule onto the booker's own slot as DUPLICATE_BOOKING. Root cause is canonical domain design; RULES-C4-1 is mandatory before any production enablement of those targets and before T-VP1–T-VP5 claims.
No empirical Wix evidence yet: gates T-VP0–T-VP5, T-WH1–T-WH6, T-BK1–T-BK4, T-RB1–T-RB2 require human-owned credentials (Contract §16); no production-capability claims exist in accepted code.
Simulated-Wix QA has never completed for any run (qa/wix-sim-latest still absent); when it lands every blocker needs an explicit repair/resolved/superseded disposition.
Projector dedup memory is unbounded until INT-C4-1(b) defines retention/compaction for long-lived serverless processes (Billing audit obs 2).
Dashboard failed-state guidance is unfollowable in the narrow first-probe-failure state until DASH-C4-1(b) lands (Dashboard audit N-A).
Downgrade-through-gate (tier drop ⇒ coverage shrink with preserved configuration) lacks a dedicated end-to-end regression until BILL-C4-1(a) lands.
Rules audit N1 obligation: the uiValidatorParity ledger fails loudly at any UI-validator drift; the future mirror repoint must consciously update it under the recorded R1–R4 decisions.
Dashboard audit N-2 (carried): root tsc does not type-check plain-JS UI sources; extend the repo gate to dashboard paths at the T-VP0 React/TS scaffold.
TOCTOU residual risk on count caps and best-effort-only reschedule enforcement remain disclosed-in-product requirements (Contract C6); copy bans re-verified clean this cycle.
next_cycle_summary: Cycle 4 closes the last known enforcement-correctness gap and completes user-facing entitlement transparency: Rules adds additive target-aware evaluation so CANCEL frees capacity and RESCHEDULE ignores the booker's own booking (audit Observation A); Integration builds the enforcement composition root on billing's projectedSnapshotSource, defines dedup retention, and exposes the token-verified GET /meter endpoint; Dashboard ships the Blueprint's LocationsUsage meter page (allowance, over-limit, upgrade CTA, degraded warnings) plus recovery-guidance honesty fixes; Billing adds the downgrade-through-gate regression and folds projection fidelity findings.
